scope: Continuous state E/D only; state LFQ removed including parameters and losses
hypothesis: Adapt GaussianGPT encoder and decoder with continuous Nx64 sparse state features on all177 native NeoVerse states
data_split: User-requested single clip TRAIN reconstruction; this source was historically DEV and previously admitted to training; no held-out claim
teacher: Offline whole-video NeoVerse WorldMirror, all177 timestamps, 112896 native GS per frame; no point/frame deletion
normalization: First TRAIN frame robust 1%-99% span determines scale=2**floor(log2(0.9/span)); apply this one power-of-two scale to all GS means/scales and camera positions, no recentering, no point deletion. Avoid float32 cancellation in thin GS.
input_gate: Fixed previous architecture grid0.008, all-point set statistics and4 output GS; measure representative error, do not silently choose a different resolution
set_fallback: Deterministic alpha-weighted mean/std of 14 attributes plus log(count), 29->128->368 residual embedding; all GS enter moments; not a lossless set representation. Learned residual multi-GS features with K=4 offsets and divided initial opacity.

train.occupancy: Official target_keep during first 80% updates; decoder.eval() for last 20% with occupancy targets used only by BCE. All evaluations always decoder.eval(), target_key=None.
train.trainable: E/D/input embedding/GS heads and set adapter/multiplier; no state quantizer parameters
train.batch: One complete frame, seeded shuffled cycling over all177 frames; GPU0; no point/frame truncation

evaluation.roi_label: Fixed boxes inspected on existing native448 contact sheet; broad activity regions include background, not semantic masks
evaluation.pass: All177 frames/coverage, full and regionPSNR within1dB of NeoVerse, teacherPSNR>=25, continuous-state replayPSNR>=60 andMAE<=1e-5, frozen decoder input gradient finite nonzero
outputs: continuous sparse state packets with Nx64float32 features and coordinates

retry_policy: No scientific retries or automatic reduced-resolution/subsampled substitute. Engineering fixes before training are recorded; runtime failure yields FAILED.json and stops.
limitations: Single source TRAIN reconstruction, historically DEV now training-used
Offline whole-clip noncausal teacher with input RGB
No physical point identity or future prediction claim
Source differs from old four MoVieS clips, not a controlled teacher comparison
Lossy set moments and4-output-GS extension, quality gates may fail
initialization: Official PhotoShape encoder/decoder plus fresh set adapter and4-output multiplier; LFQ module replaced by Identity and never called
state_quantization: None. No LFQ, no state IDs, no bit loss, no quantization auxiliary loss, no STE.
engineering_revision: Initial arbitrary centered similarity failed strict pixel parity; three-frame diagnosis found dyadic scale0.5 gives pixel-exact rendering. Keep original PSNR/MAE gates unchanged and validate all177 frames.
